1.w: Give a ringing cry, O righteous ones, in YHWH! Beautiful [is] the praise for the upright.

2.w: Give thanks to YHWH with the harp; with an instrument of ten [strings], make music to Him.

3.w: Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.

4.w: For straight [is] the word of YHWH, and all His work is trustworthy.

5.w: He loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of the loving devotion of YHWH.

6.w: By the word of YHWH the heavens were made, and by the breath of His mouth all their host.

7.w: He gathers together the waters of the sea as a heap; He lays up the depths in storehouses.

8.w: Let them be afraid of YHWH, all the earth; let all those dwelling in the world stand in awe of Him!

9.w: For He has spoken, and it came to pass; He has commanded, and it stood firm.

10.w: YHWH breaks apart the counsel of nations; He has diasllowed the plans of the peoples.

11.w: The counsel of YHWH stands forever, the plans of His heart from generation and [to] generation.

12.w: Blessed [is] the nation for whom YHWH [is] its God, the people He has chosen as the inheritance for Him.

13.w: From the heavens, YHWH looks; He sees all the sons of man.

14.w: From the fixed place of His sitting, He gazes toward all those dwelling [on] the earth.

15.w: He fashions their hearts together; He attends to all their works.

16.w: No king is saved by the abundance of [his] strength; a mighty man is not delivered by the abundance of [his] power.

17.w: [His] horse [is] a false [thing] for salvation, and in the abundance of its strength it cannot provide escape.

18.w: Behold, the eye of YHWH [is] toward those who fear Him, to those waiting on His loving devotion,

19.w: to snatch their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

20.w: Our soul waits for YHWH—He [is] our help and our shield.

21.w: For in Him our heart shall rejoice, because we have trusted in His holy Name.

22.w: May Your loving devotion, O YHWH, be upon us, as we do wait for You.
